opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt or excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Not open to individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities/councils. One application at a time; must wait a year after a previous decision before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Operating/core cost grants typically support 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be 10-20% of total costs (local community capital projects up to £30,000).

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million regardless of organisation's annual income. For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Must be an eligible UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via an Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis. Local community capital projects (e.g. churches, village halls) are advised to apply for a regular grant instead (typically up to £30,000).
